nom: Origins Clear Improvement Active Charcoal Detoxifying Face Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split by which formula they compare it to: those new to the product often report it controls shine and cleans without over-drying, while several long-time users of the discontinued Zero Oil version say the current formula leaves their oily skin feeling oily again within minutes.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin have mixed experiences: one with normal-to-dry skin reports no dryness at all, while others describe the current formula as too intense for daily use and recommend following with a moisturizer or cutting back to a few uses a week.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin consistently report the cleanser deep-cleans without stripping or leaving their skin feeling tight, and several call it a staple specifically for an oily T-zone.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: some long-time users of the old formula report new breakouts or a suspected charcoal allergy after switching, while others describe the current formula as gentle enough for daily use without irritation or dryness.

concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin who did not use the earlier formula generally report the cleanser controls shine and leaves skin feeling clean rather than oily, including with daily or humid-climate use. Long-time users of the discontinued 'Zero Oil' formula frequently disagree, reporting that skin feels oily again within minutes of washing and that the current formula does not cut oil the way the original did.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who started with the current charcoal formula, especially when paired with the matching moisturizer, often report fewer breakouts, fewer blackheads, and better-controlled acne with regular use. A large number of long-time users who switched over from the discontinued Zero Oil version report the opposite: new or worse breakouts within one to three weeks, including one who suspects a charcoal allergy.
concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers with oily or combination skin describe the cleanser as non-drying: it rinses clean without leaving skin feeling stripped, tight, or patchy, and several use it daily without issue. Others, particularly those with dry or sensitive skin, find it can be drying or too intense for daily use, and recommend a moisturizer straight after or cutting back to a few uses a week.

aspects.libelle: Widely compared unfavorably to the discontinued original
Thicker, goopier texture than the previous gel
Minty scent most current users find refreshing
Small amount lathers and goes a long way
Taller, opaque repackaging seen as a downgrade
Doubles as a gentle exfoliant used sparingly

extraits.titre: Poor replacement for a previously fantastic product
extraits.texte: This new product is a poor substitute for the original Zero Oil Deep Pore Cleanser with Saw Palmetto and Mint. I used that original for years and it was perfect! My skin went from oily to clear and baby-soft smooth instantly, and lasted all day. This new formula with Active Charcoal Detoxifying feels like it does nothing to clean, and just feels oily again before long. Really a shame to now have to search for a perfect cleanser all over again. Maybe I can find some old stock somewhere.

extraits.titre: I would NOT buy this product again.
extraits.texte: I've used origins for 15+ years and have enjoyed the old version of this because I have very sensitive skin. I don't wear facial makeup only a bit of cocoa butter for lotion. I purchased this and was highly disappointed. I had many many breakouts after a week of using this new formulation. There are many who are allergic to "charcoal" and I am apparently one of them. Please bring back the old product. It wasn't broke, so why try to improve a product that was clearly a great seller.

extraits.titre: Combo skin: this one is for you
extraits.texte: I was gifted the Clear Improvement Zero Oil Charcoal Detoxifying Face Cleanser by Origins and overall, I'm pretty happy with it! The texture is smooth with a gentle lather, and it has a refreshing, clean scent—nothing too overpowering. I really like the cooling sensation it gives during and after washing. It feels like it's doing something right away, and it definitely leaves my skin feeling clean and less oily without over-drying. However, I wouldn't call it a miracle product. It didn't completely prevent breakouts, especially around hormonal periods, but it did help reduce their severity. Also, if you have very dry or sensitive skin, this might be a little too intense for daily use.

I have combination skin, so I like that this doesn't have oil(I don't need help in that department lol, especially in the summer). This doesn't the job but isn't drying and doesn't strip but my face feels refreshed after I use it. Love Origins products.

I am really surprised at the negative reviews. I have always had sensitive skin, prone to breaking out. This cleanser always makes my skin feel so clean without over drying or breaking out. I also use the charcoal moisturizer in the morning and the plantscriptions + nightamins at night :) My skins feels the best with these products!

Gifted by Origins. Facial cleansing gel with activated carbon. This is extremely good for blackheads, dilated dicks and oily skin. This cleans your skin in depth, what's more, I could tell you that you can even use it as an exfoliant once or twice a week because if you use it every day. You could dry out your skin. It's very good but use it sparingly.

extraits.titre: so happy i found this cleanser
extraits.texte: I have very oily skin and live in a very humid climate so I'm always struggling with my skin. I have been using this cleanser for about a week and I have definitely noticed a difference. This cleanser gets my skin very clean and doesn't dry it out at all. The smell is a very very subtle minty smell that is very nice. I love this cleanser and would definitely recommend.
